root_cause_criterion.criterion: After the range-adjustment block truncates `len`, `tail` must be recomputed as `head + len` before the later `value_move()` uses it as the splice endpoint.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable path clamps `len` to the receiver array boundary but carries forward the stale pre-clamp `tail`. The fixed path restores the missing obligation by recomputing `tail` from the truncated `len`, preventing the stale endpoint from reaching the copy sink.

nodes.state: The forward-copy dereference in `value_move` reads from the same source pointer passed by `mrb_ary_splice` for the shrinking splice move.
At the shrinking splice move, the carried `tail` is still greater than `alen`, so `ptr + tail` is already beyond the logical array end when chosen as the `value_move` source.

edges.relation: The post-clamp `tail` value is reused unchanged as the splice endpoint at the later `value_move(ptr + head + argc, ptr + tail, alen - tail)` call.
The out-of-range source pointer computed as `ptr + tail` at the splice callsite is passed unchanged as `s2` into `value_move` and is the pointer dereferenced at the sink.
